mob._comment: Stats mobs share with the player block, same names + same units (backlog §27.2.3). healthGainTick is out-of-combat regen as a fraction of the max pool per tick; 0.0066667 = full pool in 5 s (PO 2026-07-26). The Go default in model/mob is the source of truth for the rate; this restates it, and removing the entry resolves back to it. NOTE: vitals.HP floors a step at 1 HP, so pools under ~150 refill in maxHealth/30 s regardless. [PLACEHOLDER]

combat._comment: Factors that apply to EVERY acting entity — player, mob, summon (backlog §25 B). Absent = the built-in defaults below. [PLACEHOLDER]
